body: Implemented: List (tree with filters, branch scope) and Board. Board columns come only from the configured statuses in their order; each ticket appears once in its stored status column; blocked/readiness and roll-ups are hints, never columns. Board can be scoped to a parent and to work items only (leaves); cards open the same stable ticket URL. Status changes by drag and drop or keyboard (Alt+←/→) through the normal update path. Also fixed: ?view=list / ?view=summary URLs showed an empty page; unknown views now fall back to Summary.
author: local
